## Core Focus Areas & Interests

### 1. Autonomous Agents & Agentic Infrastructure
- Multi-agent fleet coordination, delegation architectures, and reactive communication.
- Agent harness design, dynamic execution loops, and practical tool-use environments.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) server design, remote authenticated endpoints, and protocol integrations.
- Headless browser automation via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and multi-surface workflows.
- Evaluation of real-world model execution constraints, latency, reliability, and token economics.

### 2. Systems & High-Performance Engineering
- High-efficiency, low-footprint services and local utilities in Rust.
- Scalable backend architectures, API engineering, and distributed service design.
- Linux environment internals, containerization (Docker), local process harnesses, and shell automation.

### 3. Developer Platforms & Work Operating Systems
- Building tooling that eliminates developer friction and automates complex routine human workflows.
- Enterprise systems integrating employee lifecycles, project pods, attendance, and collaboration infrastructure.

### 4. Academic & Campus Infrastructure
- Building accessible platforms and MCP endpoints unlocking locked university ERP and LMS systems directly for AI assistants without central database overhead.

## Key Projects

### Featured Systems & Agent Work
- **Ctrl:** High-performance personal assistant and driver daemon built in Rust utilizing SQLite and embedded HTTP services.
- **LVC WorkOS:** Enterprise unified work operating system covering lifecycle management, attendance, timezone synchronization, and collaboration pods.
- **KLMCP:** Remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server bridging university ERP and LMS systems directly into AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) via authenticated endpoints without central database overhead. (https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/KLMCP)
- **Autonomous Fleet & Bot Harnesses:** Multi-agent local orchestration environments managing background ingestion, briefings, and task execution.

### Featured Web & Academic Platforms
- **KLUDesk / KLED:** High-traffic academic portal and university resource hub serving 7,500+ students. Engineered scalable backend managing 1,000+ files with sub-200ms latency and offline-first PWA access. (https://kludesk.vercel.app | https://kled.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/KLU-DESK)
- **GoSynk:** Real-time campus social network and collaborative study platform for 1,000+ users featuring live announcements, event management, notes, flashcards, and quizzes. Incorporated client-side TensorFlow.js models for automated toxic content moderation, cutting moderation load by 90%. (https://gosynk.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/gosynk)
- **SkillDex:** Dynamic AI course engine generating structured curricula and technical lessons across 50+ topics. Accelerated generation time by 50% through parallelized OpenAI and Gemini API requests. (https://myskilldex.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/SkillDex)
- **UseLAI:** AI automation and content generation tool powered by Google Gemini AI, leveraging multi-agent prompt workflows. (https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/lai)
- **Homer & newPortfolio:** Modern reactive portfolio ecosystem designed for high performance, minimalism, and custom theme customization. (https://chakresh.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/newPortfolio)
